What to find: Measures to detect or remove unsuitable data (illegal content, CSAM, NCII, unlawful personal data, harmful content).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data, Data Filtering, Safety

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: For Child Safety, pre-training data filtering is used as a first step to mitigate risk. Safety fine-tuning data uses LLM-based classifiers to select high-quality prompts and responses. The card does not describe filtering for other unsuitable data such as NCII or unlawful personal data.
quotes: We leverage pre-training methods like data filtering as a first step in mitigating Child Safety risk in our model.
We’ve developed many large language model (LLM)-based classifiers that enable us to thoughtfully select high-quality prompts and responses, enhancing data quality control.
